book.name: EFESO
book.title: Efeso wedi Leta Pol wana Luluweli

content: Pol I Kaiwo Hebwaden taine Judiya-yan Sohode kaiwadiye
Helak i ginawi sohode ti yake kaiwamiu, iyete ga yake kaiwane a hauhawanun kaiwamiu. Nau Pol mwage he dibula, kaiwane a ginawi Keriso Yeisu wana kaiwo humiu hebwaden taine Judiya-yan sohode kaiwamiu.
Anamate hobak hu longe te Helak i giyau ho mulolu ge a kaiwo kaiwamiu.
Ho mulolu gane i giyau iye te i patoheyau wana nuwotu sumosumoine ge a lapu. (Hobak hawesine a lihuyan mwao Helak wana nuwotu sumosumoine lihuine.
Iyete hebe hu pahone sahe a luluweli-yan, bwele hu paidi tolosuwok a lapu wana nuwotu sumosumoine, gane i ginawi Keriso hei.)

Sauge veto dedei bobodeidiye taine si delapu Helak wana nuwotu sumosumoine, agegene sauge ga ya Yayaluwo Gagabubine wana gaisi heine hobak i payoumate hamai wana apostol-yan ge wana profet-yan gagabubidiye heyai.

Wana nuwotu sumosumoine yake sohode ti ya. Humiu hebwaden taine Judiya-yan sohode hu goru he Wase Dodohobine, iloke hamai Judiya hene-bwaimai humiu ta ho toyao wana mulolu gane i lovivine-yan, he-bwaimai humiu hide sohode tutuwo hotaege giniteine, ge Keriso Yeisu heine ta ho toyao Helak wana lihu tuwoi.
I giyau ho mulolu a tabwa Wase Dodohobine yake hana tokaiwo. Ge i giyau wana gaisi heyau ge hei a ginginawi wana kaiwo.
Bwagane nau Helak wana bobode bwabwaligadiye wedi totankainane, i giyau ho mulolu te dohob malemaleine gane ta paidi Keriso heine, wasane a papalapu-yan hebwaden taine Judiya-yan sohode heimiu.

Helak i giyau lo kaiwo a gopawayae bobode bwabwaligadiye heidiye wana nuwotu sumosumoine gane nuwane i ginawi. Helak, iye bigi bwabwaligadiye hedi toginawi, sauge veto dedei heine wana nuwotu yake i ho sumwan.
Nuwane te sauge ya todedei ge gaisi denan he bulubulu, he ekelesiya hei iye wana sibe yauyawate si lapu.
Sauge veto dedei suwok Helak i nuwotu bwele i ginawi sohode ti yake, iyete sauge ga ya Keriso Yeisu wada Guyau wana kaiwo heine hobak i ginawi mwao.
Ge hide ta miye Keriso hei ge ta goru heine, iloke taine ta dematok te ta lok Helak he hana hao bwaide wada hatamatuwo.
Iyete a liwo heimiu, tab nuwamiu i engak ge yayaluwamiu i epwayate kaiwane nau a paidi tilao kaiwamiu. Nau lo tilao hinone te humiu hu paidi dohobine, iyete gen hu yariyae-an.
Pol I Hawanun Helak heine Efeso Gen Si Lapu Keriso wana Nunuwane hana Kaikai
Helak i ginawi sohode ti yake kaiwamiu, iyete a lopwakoko Tamade he matane,
iye hun bwabwaligadiye he bulubulu ge he panayawi hedi topayoumate.
Tamade i susuwoku-yan bigi dodohobidiye hohoyowate nuwane i yomo giyau heimiu, iyete a hawanun Yayaluwo Gagabubine wana kaiwo heine gen i pagaisi yayaluwamiu,
ge lemi goru kaiwane Keriso gen i solavi he hatiyemiu. A hawanun gen hewasiimiu i sedau he nunuwane pageine ge yawedimiu i matuwo, sohode hubwahi hewasiine i sedau ge i kukuhasik kelekele.
A hawanun he-bwaimiu ge Helak wana bobode bwabwaligadiye bosowaimiu hu lapu Keriso wana nunuwane hana malemale, hana mwalao, hana misai, ge hana midau.

Hide bobode taine bosowaine ta delapu Keriso wana nunuwane hana kaikai, age a hawanun gen hu lapu vetahe wana nunuwane yake ge hu hamnohon hamnane. Ilok Helak, iye i susuwoku-yan dohob bwabwaligane, gen i miye heimiu ge i pasusuwokumiu.
Helak wana gaisi mwage i kaikaiwo heide, iyete heto sahe ta hawanunan o hebe heto sahe ta nuwotuyan, iye bosowaine i ginawi lake.
Iyete hide hebwaden ta miye he ekelesiya gamwane ge Keriso Yeisu heine, sai ge sai ta hawa wasewase-yan Helak, sauge hohoyowate taine i edemwao. Bam, sohode.
